name: AWS — Security Hub Disabled or Standards Removed
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = amazon_aws_raw
| filter xdm.event.type in ("DisableSecurityHub","DeleteInsight","BatchDisableStandards","UpdateStandardsControl","DeleteHub","DisableImportFindingsForProduct")
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as events,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users, events_seen
description: DisableSecurityHub, DeleteInsight, BatchDisableStandards, UpdateStandardsControl, DeleteHub, or DisableImportFindingsForProduct event.
alert_name: AWS — Security Hub Disabled or Standards Removed

TA0005 - Defense Evasion: T1562.001 - Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
